summary.zh: 计算 VaR、CVaR 与回撤等风险指标
summary.en: Compute VaR, CVaR, Sharpe, Sortino, and drawdown

description.zh: 覆盖波动率、尾部风险、回撤和风险调整收益四类指标的计算方法，包含 VaR、CVaR、夏普、索提诺、最大回撤等，并附不同时间粒度的用法。适合衡量组合风险、设定风险限额或搭建风险监控看板时参考。需要准备持仓与历史收益数据。
description.en: Covers volatility, tail risk, drawdown, and risk-adjusted return metrics such as VaR, CVaR, Sharpe, Sortino, and max drawdown. Use it to measure portfolio risk or set limits. Position and return history must be provided.
